newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Money market mutual fund assets fell to $969.46 billion in the latest week from a revised $970.89 billion the prior week, an industry group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds fell $1.30 billion to $643.75 billion in the week ended on Wednesday.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds fell $931.8 million to $528.86 billion, while assets of the 260 tax-exempt funds fell $369 million to $114.89 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 321 institutional money market funds fell $131.4 million to $325.70 billion. Of these, assets of the 259 taxable money market funds increased $943.9 million to $291.88 billion, while assets of the 62 tax-exempt funds fell $1.08 billion to $33.82 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $970.89 billion from $970.88 billion.
